def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

# one task's program: the one shape, cut out by dropping every one-color row and column, mirrored left to right

from collections import Counter
d=os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR']
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
def parse(h):
    m=re.search(re.escape(h)+r' \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t)
    H,W=int(m[1]),int(m[2])
    return [[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:H]]
di1,do1,di2,do2=parse('Demo pair 1 input'),parse('Demo pair 1 output'),parse('Demo pair 2 input'),parse('Demo pair 2 output')
ti=parse('Test input')

def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0] if len(cnt)>1 else fill
    def is_marker(v): return v not in (fill,line)
    mrows=[i for i in range(H) if is_marker(g[i][0]) or any(is_marker(v) for v in g[i])]
    mrows=[i for i in range(H) if fill not in g[i] and any(is_marker(v) for v in g[i])]
    mcols=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]!=fill or i in mrows for i in range(H)) is False]
    mcols=[j for j in range(W) if any(is_marker(g[i][j]) for i in range(H))]
    out=[]
    for a,b in zip(mrows,mrows[1:]):
        row=[]
        for c,e in zip(mcols,mcols[1:]):
            cs={g[a][c],g[a][e],g[b][c],g[b][e]}
            row.append(cs.pop() if len(cs)==1 and next(iter(cs)) not in (fill,line) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
print(transform(di1)==do1, transform(di1), do1)
print(transform(di2)==do2)
print(json.dumps(transform(ti)))

def counts(grid):
    """Counter of colors in the grid."""
    from collections import Counter
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)

def dominant(grid, k=0):
    """The k-th most common color in the grid (0 = most common)."""
    return counts(grid).most_common(k + 1)[k][0]

def marked_lines(grid):
    """(rows, cols) holding at least one marker color (not one of the two most common colors)."""
    fill, line = dominant(grid), dominant(grid, 1)
    marks = {fill, line}
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v not in marks for v in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[i][j] not in marks for i in range(len(grid)))]
    return rows, cols

def crossing_map(grid):
    """Coarse map of the bands between marker-bearing gridlines: a band cell gets the color common to its four corner crossings if that color is a marker color, else the fill (most common) color."""
    fill, line = dominant(grid), dominant(grid, 1)
    rows, cols = marked_lines(grid)
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c, e in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            cs = {grid[a][c], grid[a][e], grid[b][c], grid[b][e]}
            v = cs.pop() if len(cs) == 1 else None
            row.append(v if v is not None and v not in (fill, line) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
